packages.title: Demo result: a task's heading is its title alone; a typed last try keeps its text
brief: Both findings are regressions of WP69 (verify-b2-r1-H.md, R1H-1 and R1H-2). Every file here already holds this run's uncommitted WP69/WP263 work: keep it, and change only the lines named below. Search for the quoted code if lines moved.

WEB-1612 (S2, regression R1H-1). What WP69 did: in each result card (`src/components/VoiceDemo.tsx:1190-1227`) the `

` wraps `

WEB-1613 (S1, regression R1H-2). What WP69 did: it renders `details.voice-transcript` only when `mode === "voice"` (`VoiceDemo.tsx:1278-1284`), since ‘Change the text’ shows a typed text. Why it fails: when the allowance is used, the tries-used line replaces ‘Change the text’ (`:1258-1276`), so after a typed last try, notably one with no tasks, the visitor can't see the sentence that failed. Do this: render the `<details>` when `mode === "voice" || allowanceUsed`, and update its comment to say a typed result shows its text only when ‘Change the text’ isn't there. Its summary follows the app, which says ‘See what I said’ for spoken words and ‘Original text’ for typed ones (`../TaskFlow/App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:4813`, `reviewOriginal` / `reviewOriginalText`): use `t.seeWhatISaid` when `mode === "voice"` and a new `t.originalText` otherwise, so typed words are never called ‘what I said’ (WEB-1309). Add `originalText` to `voice` in `src/content/site/types.ts` right after `seeWhatISaid` (`:170-171`), with the comment `// A typed result's transcript summary (the app's reviewOriginalText).`, and in the three files right after `seeWhatISaid`: EN `Original text` / ES `Texto original` / CA `Text original` (`../TaskFlow/App/lib/l10n/app_en.arb:19`, `app_es.arb:10`, `app_ca.arb:10`). Add `originalText` to the voice copy in `tests/support/ux-web-copy.ts` next to `seeWhatISaid` if the tester needs it.

Don't touch: the completion banner, its copy and its reveal (WD16, WD17); the circle's look; `completeTask`; the date line; the tries-used line and ‘Change the text’ / ‘Say it again’; the typing order and `showDone` (WP69); WP263's invalid-draft work; `Icon.tsx`. Existing tests: the WEB-1309 test (`tests/ux-web-voice.spec.ts`, ‘a typed result has no ‘See what I said’’, about `:3383`) types with tries left and should still pass unchanged; no existing test should need a change for WEB-1612.
acceptance: In `voice-result` (3 tasks) on `/`, `/es/` and `/ca/`, desktop and mobile, light and dark: the ARIA snapshot of `.voice-drafts` contains `heading "Doctor appointment" [level=4]` (and the other two titles alone, in each language) and `checkbox "Complete Doctor appointment"` / «Completar …» / «Completa …»; no level-4 heading's name contains the `completeTask` prefix; `artifacts/ux-web/aria/voice-result.en.txt` shows the same after the renders.

In the same states: clicking a task's title ticks its checkbox and clicking it again unticks it; ticking every task by its title still shows WD17's ‘All clear. Take a breath.’ banner above the list; each row is at least 44 px tall; the circle is still 24 × 24 px with `border-radius` 50%, filled and showing the check only when checked; the focus ring still shows on the circle with keyboard focus; the h4's computed font size is 18 px; `tests/ux-web-completion.spec.ts` passes; axe reports no violations.
`voice-result` renders (`voice-result.en.mobile.light.panel.png`, `voice-result.en.desktop.dark.panel.png`) look as before: circle, title and date line in the same places, within 2 px.

With 0 tasks stubbed and `remaining: 0` after the answer, a typed try on `/`, `/es/` and `/ca/` shows the tries-used line and one `details.voice-transcript` whose summary is `Original text` / `Texto original` / `Text original`; opening it shows the typed sentence. The same with tries left shows ‘Change the text’ and no `details.voice-transcript`. A spoken result, with tries left or not, shows the transcript with `See what I said` / «Ver lo que dije» / «Mostra què he dit». axe reports no violations, light and dark.
deviceChecks: TalkBack in Spanish on a result: moving by headings reads «Llamar al dentista» alone, and the circle is announced as «Completar Llamar al dentista», checkbox, not checked.
On a real phone, tapping a task's title ticks its circle.

packages.title: Footer: the site's own links as large as the legal row
brief: WEB-1614 (S1, regression R1G-1 of WP73, verify-b2-r1-G.md). What WP73 did: `.site-footer .footer-legal` became `font-size: 1rem` (`src/styles/legal.css:325`), as WEB-1605 asked. Why it fails: the footer's site navigation, `.footer-top nav a` (`src/styles/global.css:911-920`, 0.875rem, weight 650, `var(--muted)`), which carries the primary ‘Try it with your voice’, is now smaller than the legal row under it, so legal reads as the footer's main content (`home.{es,ca}.mobile-w320.light.full.png` last screen, `home.ca.desktop.light.full.png`).

Do this, in `src/styles/global.css` only: in the `.footer-top nav a` rule, change `font-size: 0.875rem;` to `font-size: 1rem;`. Keep the weight 650, the colour, the 44 px minimums, the hover rule and the column gaps (`:906-909`, `:1233-1235`, `:1376-1378`). global.css holds other packages' uncommitted hunks from this run (FAQ paragraph spacing, footer and 404 text-wrap, the header menu icons, the max-height block, the forced-colours language ring): leave them alone.
Don't touch: `legal.css`; the operator, © and trademark lines (still 0.875rem); `Footer.tsx`; the links' order and copy.
acceptance: On `/`, `/es/` and `/ca/` at 1440 × 1000, 390 × 664 and 320 × 568, light and dark: every `.footer-top nav a` and every `.footer-legal a` computes to 16 px; `.footer-top nav a` keeps font weight 650; the operator, © and trademark lines still compute to 14 px (the WP73 block in `tests/ux-web-frame.spec.ts` still passes).
In the same states nothing scrolls sideways (`scrollWidth` ≤ `clientWidth`), and every footer link is at least 44 × 44 px (`AUDIT.md` §5 shows 0 under 44 px).
In `home.es.mobile-w320.light.full.png` and `home.ca.desktop.light.full.png`, the footer's site links are no smaller than the legal row; axe reports no violations on the three homes, light and dark.
